objective: Select the checkpoint most ready for release as the product's sentiment classifier for customer support tickets.
rubric: Prefer the checkpoint with the higher held-out F1; treat a checkpoint that shows any bias across ticket languages as disqualifying regardless of its F1.

options.summary: RoBERTa-base fine-tuned for three epochs on the labeled ticket split.
DistilBERT fine-tuned for five epochs with class-weighted loss.
DeBERTa-v3-small fine-tuned for three epochs with label smoothing.

members.role: Judge purely on held-out F1 across the ticket categories.
Judge whether the checkpoint shows language-based bias in its errors.
Judge whether the checkpoint's inference cost fits the ticket-routing budget.
